text: Toxocara, a roundworm that can be fatal in young calves (especially buffalo calves), should be prevented/treated systematically at 2 weeks of age with Pyrantel, Piperazine, or Levamisole — Ivermectin is not effective against it. For other intestinal and lung roundworms in cattle, Ivermectin 1% (1 ml/50 kg, subcutaneous) is the most widely used option; Levamisole 7.5% (1 ml/10 kg) also works.
